name: io.github.rodolfoconcepcion/unifi-udm-pro-mcp
description: High-performance native MCP server for Ubiquiti UniFi UDM Pro / UDM SE with 40 tools. Direct local API Key authentication, ultra-low latency (10-30ms), full CRUD for Wi-Fi, VLANs, Firewall, Port Forwarding, Clients, and more.

environment_variables.name: UNIFI_HOST
environment_variables.description: The IP or hostname of your UniFi OS console (e.g., https://YOUR_UNIFI_HOST_IP)

environment_variables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Your UniFi Local API Key generated from UDM Control Plane -> Integrations
